0022600139.text: The Timberwolves (3-1) host the Golden State Warriors (0-3) in their fifth game of the season, with Minnesota 1-0 at home, 3rd in the Northwest, 6th in the West, and coming off a loss in its most recent game, while Golden State has lost three straight and sits 14th in the West. Donte DiVincenzo is out for Minnesota with an Achilles injury, and Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee). The teams have not played yet in 2026-27, and the Timberwolves won 3-1 in the 2025-26 season series, most recently beating Golden State 127-117 in San Francisco on March 13, 2026.
